lede: Feel the shimmer: B-POP Tags names DJ Shimmerie as the heart of Dhaka's underground parties, and says it isn't stopping soon.
body:
"Feel the shimmer." Our post on [@dj_shimmerie](https://www.instagram.com/dj_shimmerie/) is short, loud and confident: the heart of Dhaka's underground parties "ain't stopping soon!"

## DJ Shimmerie and Dhaka underground parties

The caption puts DJ Shimmerie at the centre of the city's underground party circuit and adds a shout-out: "[@monsoon.beatz](https://www.instagram.com/monsoon.beatz/) hit the jackpot". The hashtags, #djshimmerie, #dhakarave and #raveculture, make the setting clear.

## The visual

The cover is a burst of colour. A figure in a glittering, mirrored face mask and a patterned headscarf throws up a hand sign in front of a glitchy rainbow test-card backdrop, while a glossy purple-and-gold ribbon curls overhead. Fragments of text peek out from behind, but the post lets the energy do the talking. It's a portrait of a scene that dresses up, masks up and keeps moving.

More DJs and crews live in [Music & Rave](topic:music). Everything else is on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

faq.a: DJ Shimmerie (@dj_shimmerie) is the DJ B-POP Tags calls the heart of Dhaka's underground parties, adding that it "ain't stopping soon".
